description: OpenAPI/Swagger specification defining API endpoints and schemas related to USB Port data and operations within a hardware management system.

methods.name: Interfaces.Physical.Data.USB.Ports.List
methods.description: Retrieves a list of USB Ports with optional pagination.

methods.name: Interfaces.Physical.Data.USB.Ports.{PortId}.Get
methods.description: Retrieves details and status of specific USB Port identified by PortId.

methods.name: Interfaces.Physical.Data.USB.Ports.{PortId}.Set
methods.description: Modifies the configuration of the specified USB Port.

methods.name: Interfaces.Physical.Data.USB.Ports.{PortId}.ResetStatistics
methods.description: Resets the statistics counters for the specified USB Port.
